messages.subject: Re: ggplot color chart
parts:
Problem solved... it was a mistake from my side.
I was trying to change the color for geom_line and geom_point:

qplot(main="Title",ylim=yrange,xlim=xrange)+xlab("x")+ylab("count")+
geom_point(data=dataset,aes(x=day, y=value),alpha = 0.1,na.rm =
TRUE, colour="red")+
geom_line(data=dataset2,aes(x=day, y=value),alpha = 0.8,size=1.0,
colour="green")

To other colors, but I was using the colour names with a space, e.g.
"dark red" instead of "darkred", therefore he was not recognizing the
color names.
